title: Durable Medical Equipment Rentals Payment Class Schedule: Codes, Rental and Purchase Availability
content:
Each item placed under Durable Medical Equipment Rentals is classed by its TRICARE DMEPOS payment class, and the class settles whether the item may be rented, whether it may be bought outright at delivery, and the other standing terms shown below. The schedule covers all seven payment classes.

## Schedule of acquisition terms

| Payment class | HCPCS codes typical of the class | May be rented | May be bought outright at delivery |
|---|---|---|---|
| Inexpensive or Routinely Purchased Equipment | E0100, E0130, E0143 | Yes | Yes |
| Capped Rental Equipment | E0250, E0260, K0001 | Yes | No |
| Continuous Positive Airway Pressure Equipment | E0601, E0470 | Yes | No |
| Power Mobility Device | K0823, K0856 | Yes | Yes |
| Oxygen and Oxygen Equipment | E1390, E0431, E0439 | Yes | No |
| Frequently Serviced Equipment | E0465, E0466 | Yes | No |
| Customized Equipment | K0005, E1220 | No | Yes |

## Terms common to every class

| Term | Inexpensive or Routinely Purchased | Capped Rental | Continuous Positive Airway Pressure | Power Mobility Device | Oxygen and Oxygen Equipment | Frequently Serviced | Customized |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Item must be for use in the home | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Patient pays the difference for an upgrade beyond what is medically necessary | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Fee schedule that sets the purchase amount | TRICARE DMEPOS fee schedule for the state of residence | same | same | same | same | same | same |

## Reading the schedule

- The HCPCS codes listed are the codes typical of each class; they are examples of the class, not a closed list of every code in it.
- Rental only: Capped Rental Equipment, Continuous Positive Airway Pressure Equipment, Oxygen and Oxygen Equipment and Frequently Serviced Equipment may be rented and may not be bought outright at delivery.
- Rental or outright purchase: Inexpensive or Routinely Purchased Equipment and Power Mobility Device may be either rented or bought outright at delivery.
- Purchase only: Customized Equipment may be bought outright at delivery and may not be rented.
- In every class the purchase amount is the amount on the TRICARE DMEPOS fee schedule for the patient's state of residence, and in every class an upgrade beyond what is medically necessary leaves the difference to the patient.

### Illustration (hypothetical)

A hypothetical walker coded E0130 falls in Inexpensive or Routinely Purchased Equipment, so the schedule allows it to be rented or bought outright at delivery. A hypothetical oxygen concentrator coded E1390 falls in Oxygen and Oxygen Equipment, so the schedule allows it to be rented but not bought outright at delivery.
